item.title: I was recognized as a "top reviewer" for NeurIPS 2026
item.description:
I did not submit a single paper to this year, and honestly I had no plans to attend. Then I (susprisingly) received an email informing me that, based on my performance as a reviewer, I have been granted a free registration!

This is a nice initiative, which both encourages and recognizes reviewers’ efforts, and I hope that more conferences will follow NeurIPS’ example. I will then be attending online.

item.title: Presenting the ARC challenge at GPTP
item.description:
My first participation in the (GPTP) was super-interesting. There was a lot of time for extended plenary discussions, which is usually a feature missing from larger conferences.

The focus of my presentation was the challenge, and I tried to push the Genetic Programming crowd to participate in the current Kaggle competition, as I believe it could be GP’s chance to shine! I’ve also shown some preliminary results in a joint work with Alberto Moraglio from University of Exeter.

It was an absolute pleasure to meet again Travis Desell, James McDermott, Giorgia Nadizar, Una-May O’Reilly, Leonardo Truijllo, and many other brilliant colleagues. Thanks to Michigan State University (MSU) and Wolfgang Banzhaf for hosting and organizing the event!
